params.name: Vex Hornet
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/hornet.mjs (edit that, not this). A two-seat mini VTOL built like a small upright city car: one box four metres long, a short round nose with two round lamps standing out of it, the screen starting almost at the nose, deep glass, a roof in a second colour, grey cladding, coach doors hinged at the back, a flat hatch with upright lamps, four small ducted fans tucked into the corners where the wheels would be, a pusher low in the hatch and three feet with mag-lock pucks. 4.0 m long. docs/proposals/hover-cars.md.

parts.name: body
parts.note: The shell. The glass is the loft's own faces, glazed (cabin-hornet.js). The roof is the loft's crown faces in the trim colour. Lamps, strips, seams and the badge are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
